items.title: Nvidia says 'no' to rehiring Huang and WSJ reports SEC is probing the chipmaker
items.summary: WASHINGTON/SAN FRANCISCO, Nov 17 (Reuters) - Nvidia's leadership signaled they would brook no dissent in their plan to find a new CEO, rejecting a "Stand With Jensen" campaign from allies of departed CEO Jensen Huang, even as the Wall Street Journal reported a regulator was probing Nvidia. A growing effort to reinstate Huang had complicated the search, and Huang said on Tuesday he would be "honored" to return if the ‌board deemed it best.

items.title: Qualcomm vs. SK Hynix: Stable Revenue vs. Rapid Acceleration
items.summary: SK Hynix's quarterly revenue has surged from $12.1 billion to $73.3 billion in under two years, while Qualcomm's has barely budged.

items.title: Brad Gerstner Dumps These 3 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBrad Gerstner’s Altimeter Capital sold all of its Applied Materials, KLA and Qualcomm shares in the third quarter, and in the same quarter it added to Meta Platforms and opened a position in Tesla. Applied Materials and KLA have each fallen 52% since June 30, even though both just reported strong quarters, and analysts’ average targets sit more than 50% above both stocks.
